questions.question: Of the 3 numbers whose average is 40, the first is 1/3 rd the sum of other 2. What is the first number?
questions.solution:
Let the first number be a

⇒ Sum of all the 3 numbers = 3 × 40 = 120

⇒ a = (1/3)(120 - a)

⇒ a = 40 - a/3

⇒ 4a/3 = 40

∴ a = 30

questions.question: A student has to secure 40% marks to pass. He gets 67 and fails by 13 marks. What is the maximum marks?
questions.solution:
Given: Passing % = 40%

Marks got = 67

Number of more marks needed to pass = 13

So, passing marks = 67 + 13 = 80

Let a be the maximum marks

⇒ a × (40/100) = 80

⇒ 0.4a = 80

∴ a = 200

questions.question: If (-1/2) × (x - 5) + 3 = -5/2, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Given: (-1/2) * (x - 5) + 3 = -5/2

Multiplying above equation by 2

⇒ -(x - 5) + 6 = -5

⇒ -x + 5 + 6 = -5

⇒ -x = -16

∴ x = 16

questions.question: If the shopkeeper sells an item at Rs. 4400 which is marked as Rs 5000, then what is the discount that he is offering?
questions.solution:
Let shopkeeper is offering x% of discount

So, Selling price = marked price × (1 - discount/100)

⇒ 4400 = 5000 × (1 - x/100)

⇒ 44/50 = 1 - x/100

⇒ x/100 = 1 - 44/50 = 6/50

∴ x = 6/50 × 100 = 12%

questions.question: What is the sum of the 13 terms of an arithmetic progression, if the first term is -10 and the last term is 26?
questions.solution:
Given: The first term = -10

The last term = 26

The total numbers (n) = 13

⇒ Sum of AP = n/2[First term + Last term]

⇒ Sum of AP = 13/2[-10 + 26] = 13/2(16)

∴ Sum of AP = 104

questions.question: A can do a work in 36 days and B in 12 days. If they work on it together, then in how many days will they be able to do the work?
questions.solution:
1 day’s work of A = 1/36

1 day’s work of B = 1/12

1 day’s work of A and B together = 1/36 + 1/12 = 4/36 = 1/9

∴ A and B together will be able to do the work in 9 days

questions.question: In what ratio does the point T(x, 0) divide the segment joining the points S(-4, -1) and U(1, 4)?
questions.solution:
Lets take that Point T divides SU in the ratio k₁ : k₂ , then the coordinates of point T are given by this formula:

⇒ xT = (k₁xU + k₂xS)/(k₁ + k₂) and yT = (k₁yU + k₂yS)/(k₁ + k₂)

⇒ xT = (k₁xU + k₂xS)/(k₁ + k₂) and 0 = (4k₁ - k₂)/(k₁ + k₂)

⇒ xT = (k₁xU + k₂xS)/(k₁ + k₂) and 4k₁ = k₂

Since, k₁/k₂ = 1 : 4 is satisfied by just one option, we don’t need to simplify xT term.

questions.question: If tanθ = 4/3, then what is the value of Sinθ?
questions.solution:
Since, there are no negative values in the options. We can take these values as the angle of a right angled triangle with base = 3 cm and perpendicular = 4 cm

And the angle θ be the angle between base and hypotenuse

⇒ hypotenuse = √(3² + 4²)

⇒ hypotenuse = 5 cm

So, sinθ = perpendicular/hypotenuse = 4/5 = 0.8 cm

questions.question: If the total expenses of the company are Rs. 50 crores, the total expenditure (in Rs. crores) on Transport and Electricity is:
questions.solution:
Given: total expenses of the company = 50 crore

Total expenditure (in Rs. crores) on Transport and Electricity = 50 × [15/100 + 25/100]

⇒ 50 × [40/100]

⇒ Rs. 20 crores

questions.question: The flight fare between two cities is increased in the ratio 9 : 11. What is the increase (in Rs) in the fare, if the original fare was Rs. 18,000?
questions.solution:
Let Original price of the ticket and new price of the ticket is Rs. 9x and 11x respectively.

So, 9x = Rs. 18000

⇒ x = 2000

Hence, new price of the ticket = 11 × 2000 = Rs. 22000

∴ Increased price of the ticket = 22000 - 18000 = Rs. 4000

questions.question: At what point does the line 2x - 3y = 6 cut the Y axis?
questions.solution:
Y- axis can also be written as x = 0

So, the point of intersection should satisfy both the lines.

Putting x = 0 in 2x - 3y = 6

⇒ -3y = 6

⇒ y = -2

Hence, (0, -2) satisfies both the lines

questions.question: The areas of two similar triangles ΔABC and ΔPQR are 36 sq cms and 9 sq cms respectively. If PQ = 4 cm then what is the length of AB (in cm)?
questions.solution:
Since, ΔABC and ΔPQR are similar triangles.

And Ar(ΔABC) = 4[Ar(ΔPQR)]

Let the ratios of base and height be a

And let the base and height of ΔABC be b₁and h₁

So, 1/2 × (b₁)(h₁) = 4[1/2 × (ab₁)(ah₁)]

⇒ a² = 1/4

⇒ a = 1/2

So, PQ = a × AB

⇒ PQ = 1/2 × AB

∴ AB = 4 × 2 = 8 cm

A trader buys 500 kg of cotton for Rs 9,000. 10% of this cotton is spoiled due to rain. At what rate (Rs/Kg) should he sell the rest to earn 10% profit?
questions.solution:
Given: 10% of cotton is spoiled

⇒ Remaining good cotton = 500 - (10/100)(500) = 500 - 50 = 450

Let the selling price of cotton be Rs a/kg

Total SP = 9000(1 + 10/100) = 9000 × 1.1 = Rs 9900

⇒ a = Total SP/Total kg of cotton

∴ a = 9900/450 = 22

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (-0.5, 6) in the x-axis?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (-0.5, 6) in the x-axis

⇒ the equation of line is: y = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁, y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = -2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = 0

So, we have

(x + 0.5) = 0 and (y - 6) = -2(6)/(1)

⇒ x = -0.5 and y -6 = -12

∴ x = -0.5 and y = -6

If a - b = 1 and ab = 6, then what is the value of a³ - b³?
questions.solution:
Given: a - b = 1 and ab = 6

We know that: (a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b)

⇒ 1³ = a³ - b³ - 3(6)(1)

⇒ 1 = a³ - b³ - 18

∴ a³ - b³ = 19

questions.question: The ratio of company's expenditure on Raw material to Transport is:
questions.solution:
Let the total expenditure be a

Company's expenditure on Raw material = a × (30/100) = 0.3a

Company's expenditure on transport = a × (15/100) = 0.15a

∴ Required ratio = 0.3a/0.15a = 2 : 1
